theme.title: Theme & Appearance
theme.description: Choose between light, dark, or system default mode.

language.title: Display Language

offDays.title: Institute Off-Days & Calendar
offDays.description: Manage official holidays and the dates when the institute remains open during them
offDays.observeHolidaysDescription: When enabled, official national calendar holidays are considered non-working days during term scheduling and session calculations.
offDays.customOffDaysDescription: Non-working dates specific to this institute (such as retreats, institutional events, or mid-term breaks)
offDays.noCustomOffDays: No custom off-days registered for this institute.
offDays.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to remove this off-day from the institute calendar?
offDays.addModalDescription: Select the date and enter a title for the institute's custom off-day.
offDays.calendarDescription: Click an official holiday to change its status. Selected dates appear above the calendar.
offDays.selectedDatesDescription: These changes will be applied after you save.
